# ArabiyaPath

> Learn Arabic online — Gulf (Khaleeji) Arabic, Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha), and spoken vocabulary courses with native audio, quizzes, and certificates.

ArabiyaPath teaches Arabic to expats, professionals, and language learners through structured levels, native-recorded audio, spaced-repetition vocabulary, and assessments. The two main learning tracks are Gulf Arabic (used across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman) and Fusha / Modern Standard Arabic.
